actual_Boolean_family: All labelled Boolean sign tables on n=1,2,3,4 inputs (uniform cube); parity lifts and two-cell selectors of all n<=3 seeds; two-dummy point-flip surgery on all n<=3 seeds
symmetry_reduction: B,H,I,Inf_i depend only on the squared spectrum, so the rigorous interval pass runs once per distinct squared-spectrum vector; Delta_i needs restriction spectra, so its rigorous pass runs once per distinct key (squared spectrum, per-coordinate unordered pair of restriction squared spectra). Both keys are exact invariants, no group action is assumed.
arithmetic: Integer Walsh transform; masses as exact integers over 4^n; every log is log2 of a positive integer <= 2*4^n, enclosed by mpmath interval arithmetic at 120 bits; statistics are interval sums; extremal values also reported as exact rational combinations of log2 primes
statistics: max_f B_{i*}/Inf_{i*} at a max-influence coordinate i*
purpose: Certified small-dimension calibration of the good-coordinate and aggregate-erasure constants entering C018 and the lead's localization theorem; independent re-implementation of A001/A002 load-bearing identities. Finite checks do not prove universal FEI.
